description: Client is a 60-year-old older adult who experienced significant financial challenges and was declared bankrupt in April 2026. Following considerable effort, she has recently managed to stabilize her situation and successfully opened a bank account, enabling her to actively seek employment. A working handphone is essential for her to communicate with potential employers, coordinate medical appointments, attend social work appointments, and manage her daily needs independently. Given her limited financial resources, she is unable to purchase a replacement device and would greatly appreciate support through a second-hand handphone.

passiton.name: Oppo A17K Phone
passiton.description:
Oppo A17K phone to donate. Didn’t bring it out of the house before and very lightly used. No box, has original plug/ wire and phone only. 

The OPPO A17k is an entry-level smartphone featuring a 6.56-inch HD+ display, a 5000mAh battery, and an 8MP rear camera. Key Specifications :
* Display: 6.56-inch IPS LCD (1612 × 720 pixels, 60Hz refresh rate)
* Processor: MediaTek Helio G35 
* Memory & Storage: 3GB RAM with expandable virtual RAM support, plus 64GB internal storage (microSDXC slot available)
* Cameras: 8MP rear camera and 5MP front-facing selfie camera 
* Battery & Charging: 5000mAh battery using microUSB 2.0 
* Software: Android 12 with ColorOS 12.1

***** Prefer to self collect at Thanggam LRT Station
